title: Legal cases
description: Cases the shop has taken to court for defaulted contracts. A case never changes what a customer owes: no fee or cost is ever added. A lawyer sees only the cases assigned to them.

filters.search: Case number, court number, contract number, customer name or phone

loadFailed: The legal cases could not be loaded.

open.title: Open a legal case for contract {number}
open.description: The case is opened with the contract's customer and the claim below. You can add the court details later.
open.lawyerHelp: A lawyer is needed before the case is filed.
open.claimHelp: At most what the contract still owes: {amount}. Court costs are never part of it.
open.claimTooHigh: The claim can't be more than what the contract still owes ({amount}).
open.blockNotice: Opening a case blocks the customer from new installment sales. Closing the case does not unblock them: you lift the block yourself from the customer's page.

case.title: Case {number}
case.notFoundHint: It may be another shop's case, or assigned to another lawyer.
case.loadFailed: The case could not be loaded.

fileNeeds.lawyer: To file the case, first assign a lawyer.
fileNeeds.court: To file the case, first add the court.
fileNeeds.number: To file the case, first add the court case number.

close.title: Close case {number}
close.description: Closing records how the case ended. It changes nothing on the contract or the customer: a write-off or settlement is done on the contract page, and the customer stays blocked until you lift it.
close.noEffect: Closing did not change the contract or the customer.

edit.title: Edit case {number}
edit.claimLocked: The claim can't change once the case is filed.

amounts.title: Amounts
amounts.hint: Payments are taken on the collection screen like any other. This page only shows them.
amounts.collections: Collections since the case was opened
amounts.noCollections: No collections since the case was opened.

hearings.title: Hearings
hearings.addDescription: A past date is fine: use it to record history.

notes.title: Notes
notes.hint: Notes are never edited or deleted.

documents.uploadFailed: The paper could not be uploaded.
documents.openFailed: The paper could not be opened.
documents.typeNotAllowed: Only images (JPG, PNG, WebP) and PDF files are accepted.
